notes.title: Version 2.0.0 - The Betrayer's War Expansion Now Available!
notes.content:
-	Act II: The Betrayer's War (New Expansion). Continue your campaign, and save Terrinoth from the fearsome might of the dragonlord Levirax! 
-	Act II Quick Start (New Feature). Use your completed Act I: Blood and Flame save file to play Act II, or start fresh with guided setup and story recap. 
-	Hungarian now available as a supported language for Act I: Blood and Flame.
-	Unique voices now included for all recurring Boss enemies. 
-	Various bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Now Available
notes.content:
- Addressed issues with German localization values for Campaign Log entries. 
- Addressed issues with Enemy Health and Defense value displays. 
- Fixes to display, arrangement for Rules Reference terms.
- Various bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Now Available
notes.content:
New features
- AsmoConnect Service: Sign up or log in to enable cross platform cloud saves for your campaigns.
- Enemy Resistances: Greater trials await as enemies grow more resilient on Heroic and Warfare.
- Action Tracking: Keep track of your hero’s actions during play.
- Campaign Log: Refresh your memory of the story so far.
Improvements
- Graphic settings now available in the options menu on PC / Mac.
- Interruption window added to final step of Darkness Phase.
- Various bug fixes and improvements.

notes.content: - Minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Version 1.0.11 Now Available
notes.content:
- Failing the finale quest will now properly reward items and feat progress as expected before trying the quest again
- Feat names are now displayed on the quest summary screen
- Fixed a crash related to Blood Witch activations
- Various minor bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 Now Available
notes.content:
- Improvements to the Crafthall: The ability to view currently equipped weapon parts, and the ability to immediately equip a crafted weapon part.
- Selecting an enemy portrait during its spawn message will recenter the camera on its spawn location.
- Fixed various issues related to obtaining items
- New language content added.
- Various other bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 Now Available
notes.content:
- UX improvements to the Crafthall: The ability to view currently equipped weapon parts, and the ability to immediately equip a crafted weapon part.
- UX improvement to enemy spawns: Selecting an enemy portrait during its spawn message will recenter the camera on its spawn location.
- Fixed an issue that caused base items to be rewarded after already obtaining the upgraded version.
- Fixed an issue that caused certain items to become unobtainable.
- New language content added.
- Various other bug fixes and improvements.
